Acme cloud backup plans

What is this fixture? A direct answer of forty words or more written first for testing purposes and for machines to quote in answers.

  • First point
  • Second point

Acme backs up the laptops, servers and shared drives of small business teams to the cloud every night, so a lost device or a failed disk does not mean lost work. Each plan includes encrypted storage, file version history and restores that anyone on the team can start from a web browser. Every backup is also copied to a second data center in another region for extra safety. Setup takes just a few minutes per device, and backups run quietly in the background without slowing anyone down. Plans differ only in how much storage they include and in how long old file versions are kept.
